name: loading-region
title: Loading region
description: A box that handles waiting: nothing for 300 ms, then a skeleton when the layout is known or a spinner when it is not, shown for at least 500 ms; keeps old data and shows a small spinner on reload; busy and status text for screen readers; error and empty at the same height.

props.name: status
props.description: Where the data is: "loading" (fetching), "ready" (show the children), "empty" (nothing came) or "error".

props.name: children
props.description: The real content. It stays on screen while the same region loads again.

props.name: skeleton
props.description: A skeleton with the shape and size of the content. Give it when the layout is known before the data is there; leave it out when it is not, and the region shows a spinner instead.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: The least height of the box in pixels (or any CSS length), kept in every state. Match it to the content. Default 160.

props.name: empty
props.description: Content for "empty", such as an `EmptyState`. Default is a line of text.

props.name: error
props.description: Content for "error". Default is the `labels.error` line.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called by the retry button. With no handler there is no button.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait before any indicator shows. Default 300.

props.name: minDuration
props.description: Milliseconds an indicator that has appeared stays at least. Default 500.

a11y.text: The box is aria-busy while it waits. A persistent role="status" line says Loading (or Updating on a reload) once an indicator shows, then Loaded, the error or the empty text. A load that finishes before the delay announces nothing. The skeleton is aria-hidden; the error is plain text with a real button.
The retry button is a native button with a 44 px target and a visible focus ring. Nothing else in the region takes focus, and the old content stays focusable while it reloads.
The spinner stops and the fade between states is off under reduced motion (MotionConfig reducedMotion is user). Only opacity animates.
